items.item: 1. The breadth of a life's reach (Fable 2.1 and hole 1)
items.how: The sentence 'A life's reach, along being affected, holds everything that can affect its continuation at some remove: what sustains it and what draws on the same conditions alike.' is word for word the fronts' sentence (screen, one page, USES, THE-THEORY, GLOSSARY). It now also stands after the definition in 07's thesis and in 07 §4's opening, 08:92, ONE-ARGUMENT:94, COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION:30 and PHILOSOPHY:143, placed as the screen places it. It is exact to the Lean: AffectedBy g h := ∃ c, W.DependsOn g c ∧ L.Exchanges h c, where Exchanges is taking from or giving to c at some step; WithinInfluence is the closure of AffectedBy. So givers to a condition the life depends on, and takers from it, both lie within the reach. The thesis clause 'along feeding, narrower than being affected, the condition can fail where relations of being affected close, and a listed item beyond a center's reach parts self-concern from being increasing in admission' is also exact. FedFrom implies AffectedBy (affectedBy_of_fedFrom), so feeding is the narrower relation. Drawing.returning_feeding_apart gives the condition held de se at the returning formations as Unrestricted along Affects and AffectedBy and not along FedFrom; Drawing is mutually dependent (mutual_not_fed). exists_increasingInOwn_not_increasing_of_outside, given `within` (own marks only what the line reaches), concludes ∃ O, IncreasingInOwn ∧ ¬ Increasing. §4's new passage cites each of these with its hypotheses: the marking reading only that reach; a balanced pair, each taking from the condition the other depends on, nothing given; neither in the other's feeding closure, said as 'neither feeds the other', which is weaker and true. The anchors it links exist (§1 what-forms-and-what-is-supplied, 05 r-mutual-dependence-and-its-pace). It sits after the scope-order sentence, so OPEN_LEAD['scope-order'] is whole. OPEN_LEAD['life'] and PHILOSOPHY:143's quotation moved with the inserted sentence; open_lead_errors() and check_dossiers both give 0.

items.item: 4. The alignment reading (07 'Within the whole map', AJ PLAN §1)
items.how: (b) 'The route from self-concern to counting that loss needs more' is astra's correction: the ethics offered counts losses that do not return. (c) 'what it drains can affect, at some remove, what it depends on' is Fable's gloss of membership in the influence closure. With the order's hypothesis named (its own continuation read as that closure), 'ranks above what it widens every widening that adds to that closure' is IncreasingInOwn by definition. 'so every widening that keeps what it drains where the other course loses it' follows, since the drained formation is marked. (a) The coupling bound cited (03 r-selection-through-couplings, Web.selects_alike_iff) says that histories alike through a formation's couplings are selected alike by every selection through them. 'its selection cannot respond differently to that difference through its couplings' is that, under an antecedent stronger than it needs ('nor can affect … what it depends on'), so it says no more than is proved. (d) is inside the [AI reading] bracket, as a reading. No live file quoted the old sentences; only PLAN's own dated note keeps them. PLAN's new relative link to 03 resolves (six levels up to the root) and its anchor exists.

summary: The reading agent's round checks out against the Lean and the homes. I opened every declaration it names. It says the breadth of a life's reach along being affected (AffectedBy's closure: what sustains a life and what draws on the same conditions). It says that the relation is a reading, with feeding the narrower one along which the condition fails in Drawing. It says the persisting bound of the course actually taken (persists_not_listsAdmitted's W.level), and that the order is not assumed asymmetric. It corrects the alignment reading's three sentences: the self-concern route, the closure gloss and the coupling bound. It names the open target by the dynamics, as Ren's 10 November words ask. No sentence says more than is proved. The old frame did not return. No anchor, quote or pin broke, and no person or protected file was touched. I found no high or medium problem. I fixed three low ones: the record hypothesis that still gave the bound of a course of the line's own, the Open list's lead that called the set-aside warrant open, and one Chinese term in ranking-under-readings. I report three more lows for their owners: P2 and P4 losing 'not settled by formal work' in 08's open part, item 12's 'philosophical' label, and two Chinese wordings of the persisting sentence.
